thread:
jamie: FYI Amber Labs (POC) wants to push final MSA/DPA this week. Two items blocking signature: CFO requires net-60 PO language, and their procurement team asked for an alternate signer (VP Finance) instead of the AE. Also they requested an explicit EU data residency callout in the DPA. can legal take a look?

marta_legal: tagging to confirm scope. Do we have their proposed redlines? link?

jamie: dropping the doc here: https://drive.google.com/amberlabs-msadpa-redlines (internal read-only). Their redlines are inline, but highlights: change SLA credits to 20% for downtime >1h, add net-60 PO term, and add clause for "EU-only processing" under DPA Annex A.

ben_ae: Quick note — sales approved alternate signer but need Procurement sign-off on PO net-60 (we usually do net-30).

raj_procurement: net-60 is ok for them but need a finance contact on the PO. Who will sign? CFO or VP Finance? Also need invoice remit address + tax info.

jamie: VP Finance (name: Lina Cheng) will sign. Invoice remit should go to Amber Labs AP: ap@amberlabs.com. tax id provided in doc.

marta_legal: skimmed redlines. Two legal asks: 1) Indemnity carveouts — they removed our liability cap, we need to restore to 1x fees. 2) SLA credit mechanics are ambiguous. Propose this replacement block:

```
SLA Credits: If Service availability falls below 99.5% for a calendar month, Customer may request a service credit equal to 20% of that month's fees for the impacted service. Credits are Customer's sole and exclusive remedy.
```

marta_legal: Also we can add an EU processing paragraph but need to confirm subprocessor list and data export controls. Kai, can you attach the subprocessor inventory?

kai_sec: attaching subprocessor inventory in #eng-security; short answer: we have EU-region processing available on Dedicated and Hosted EU region. For Private deployments, customer-managed network. Need Amber to confirm they want hosted-eu.

jamie: Amber confirmed they want EU hosting for PII. I'll add that to the DPA annex.

ben_ae: legal: are you comfortable with the alternate signer being Lina? Any special authorization language needed on the PO?

marta_legal: we just need a line on the PO: "Authorized signatory for Customer: Lina Cheng, VP Finance" and a signature block. I'll add a 1-liner to the order form.

raj_procurement: Clarify billing timeline: Net-60 starts from invoice date or delivery? Amber wants from invoice. Is that acceptable?

marta_legal: standard is from invoice date. ok. Add "Net 60 from invoice date" to the order form.

jamie: great. I'll incorporate legal edits and re-upload. Expecting to send DocuSign today if we can finalize.

marta_legal: also pushing back on unlimited data export permission in their DPA redline. Need to limit export to admin-approved endpoints and subject to SCCs.

kai_sec: confirm we will apply SCCs for EU transfers. We require customer acceptance. I'll prepare the SCC pack and flag any subprocessor exceptions.

jamie: Uploaded the revised docs here: https://drive.google.com/amberlabs-msadpa-final-v2 (internal). Please review quickly — aiming for DocuSign send at 16:00 PT.

marta_legal: reviewed, minor tweaks to indemnity language and added the authorized signer line. Looks good to send.

ben_ae: Sales ops — please create PO with Net 60 and Lina Cheng as authorized signer.

raj_procurement: Created PO 2026-AL-089, Net 60 from invoice. Sending to Amber AP now.

docusign-bot: DocuSign envelope created: envelopeId=0a9f... Sent to lina.cheng@amberlabs.com for signature (1 signer).

jamie: pinging Amber to confirm Lina received.

lina_cheng (external): I got the DocuSign link, signing now.

docusign-bot: Envelope completed: envelopeId=0a9f..., signed by lina.cheng@amberlabs.com at 2026-03-21T16:24:12Z.

jamie: Received executed MSA/DPA and PO. Thanks all — closing loop. :tada:
